frozen_body: Projective twistor space is the proposed natural base of the Euclidean-first theory.

reconstruction.projective_twistor_meaning: exact projective quotient of nonzero T=C4 vectors
reconstruction.source_role: W01 assigns PT the base role for the Euclidean-first formulation

rationale: The mathematical carrier and projective/fiber semantics are already closed. The remaining source burden is the W01 role assignment that this exact PT carrier is the natural base of the Euclidean-first proposal.
guards: Natural-base is source role metadata, not a new mathematical operator.
No claim is made that PT is the base of later revised W04c/W04e formulations.
No Lisi or cross-track semantics are used.
